new_findings.source: Authenticated GitHub API: releases and tags
new_findings.issue: Four published GitHub releases from 2025-07-31 (v1.0.0, v1.0.1, v1.0.3, version-1.0.0) still offer app-release.apk, app-debug.apk and .deb downloads. Only version-1.0.0 still exists as a tag. The README says "There is no published release yet" and the matrix says NOT_RELEASED. The README also says the previously committed signing key must be considered compromised, so these APKs may be signed with it.
evidence: gh api repos/Outer-Void/termux-background/releases (2026-11-04)
git ls-remote --tags: only refs/tags/version-1.0.0
new_findings.next_action: OV-49 checks which key signed the APKs. Owner decides (D-13) whether to unpublish or mark the releases deprecated; the README must state the truth
